{{Quote|We've received confirmation from Boonda's Moon. The drone barge will be waiting for us when we reach the moon's orbit.''"<br />"''Very good, Officer. Boonda's Moon indeed! Leave it to a Hutt to name an entire planetoid after himself.|[[Dylak]] and [[Groot]]|<ref name="Missions 9" />}}
'''Boonda's Moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was one of at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the massive [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Kleeva]].

==History==
{{Quote|Why doesn't the Empire just take over Boonda's factory?''"<br />"''If we took over his factory, we'd only create trouble with other Hutts. Hutts are dastardly criminals, but they're effective in business. It's better to have Boonda working with us than against us.|[[Pelvin]] and [[Groot]]|<ref name="Missions 9" />}}
[[File:Boondas_Moon.jpg|thumb|left|195px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] landed in the [[recycling fields]] on Boonda's Moon]]
[[Boonda/Legends|Boonda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] won [[Kleeva]]'s third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in an illegal card game. He decided to make it his home and named it after himself.<ref name="Missions 9" />

Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[6 BBY/Legends|5.5 BBY]],<ref name="Droids 4" /> Boonda secretly ended his criminal career, though he encouraged others to believe that he was still a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], especially the other Hutts, who believed that running an honest business was the worst crime of all.<ref name="Missions 9" />

Boonda built a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Boonda's fortress|factory]] on his moon that was completely legal. His factory manufactured many different kinds of droids that were all well made and affordable. Over the years, Boonda's business turned out to be extremely successful and he became one of the wealthiest Hutts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Missions 9" />

Later on, in the midst of 5.5 BBY, a [[droid rebellion]] occurred when [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] led various disgruntled and angered droids against [[Boonda/Legends|Boonda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The rebellion ended with the freeing of all of the droids.<ref name="Missions 9" />

The droid factory was still one of the Hutts's most legitimate business by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], during which it gained some repute.<ref name="TEA" />
{{Moon-stub}}
